tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung 'bum smon lam gyi skor bzhugs so// swa sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gcig bsdus nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro la dga' bde'i dpal ster zhing / /gdams pa'i snying pos skal ldan rjes 'dzin pa/ /bla chen sa skya pa la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gang sku byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i dpal mnga' zhing / /gzi brjid phung po brtan par bzhugs pa yi/ /g.yas phyogs mkhyen pa'i sgo 'byed 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /g.yon du gdams pas rgyud gtams bi rū pa/ /de dag mdun du 'dren mchog bla ma dang / /tshe dang 'od zer dpag med lha mchog gnyis/ /'od zer drwa bas mdzes pa'i gur nang du/ /rje btsun mal gyo zhang ston chos 'bar dang / /dkon mchog rgyal po ba ri thugs rje can/ /rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dpon bzhugs/ /de dag kha skong dang bcas brgyud pa'i rim/ /gong bstar rin chen mdzes pa'i khri steng na/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i dpal gyi brgyud rim dang / /g.yas bstar gser gyi ba gam brtsegs pa'i steng / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i brgyud pa'i rim pa bzhugs/ /g.yon bstar zla dkar phreng ba bsgrigs pa'i steng / /byang sems smon 'jug brgyud pa'i rim pa dang / /kun gyi bstan srung nag po chen po rnams/ /tshul bzhin bzhengs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ /gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar gang thob de/ /'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po yab sras gyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin legs rdzogs nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la byin rlabs 'jug phyir bsngo/ /e wam̐ chos kyi 'byung gnas gnas mchog 'di/ /dam pa'i chos dang longs spyon kun ldan zhing / /nye bar 'tshe ba mtha' dag rab zhi nas/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus rgyas par shog /sa pho 'brug gi lo la shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges bsgrub pa'o// //dge'o// ༈ //bla ma nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku'i ngos nas bshus te bris pa'i brgyud 'debs//

༄༅/ /om̐ swa sti/ zung 'jug mchog gi sa brnyes rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba kun bdag ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /phung sogs rnam dag gdan gsum tshang ba yi/ /skur bskyed dkyil 'khor lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mthu stobs bsam yas dpal ldan bir+wa pa/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis rnam grol nag po pa/ /bde stong mchog gi dbang phyug ḍā ma ru/ /gnyis spangs spyod pa mdzad la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gangs can 'dul mdzad ga ya dha ra dpal/ /dam chos gter mdzod bla chen 'brog mi'i zhabs/ /nus mthu mthar phyin se ston kun rig dang / /yon tan mnga' brnyes chos 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro kun thugs rjes dga' mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes snying po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gsang gsum kun 'dus gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun sa skya pa la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mi thub zla ba'i sprul pa bsod nams rtse/ /rdo rje 'dzin sa bdun brnyes grags pa'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs mi yi don mdzad chos kyi rje/ /bla chen 'phags pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin tshogs sgom pa/ /nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin nyan chen pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin dkon mchog dpal/ /rim gnyis mthar phyin brag phug pa la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mdo rgyud kun mkhyen mtshungs med ri khrod pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdag po dpal ldan pa/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bud+dha shrī la 'dud/ /gsung rab kun 'dzin mkhyen pa'i gter mnga' ba/ /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba kun 'dzin thugs rje'i gter mnga' ba/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong khyer gsum 'jig thub bstan grong khyer skyong / /'jigs rung zhal gdangs 'jigs rung gad rgyang sgrogs/ /dpung chen nus mthus bdud kyi dpung chen 'joms/ /bstan srung khyod kyis bstan pa 'di skyong shig/

༈ //sde pa a seng pas gsung ngag brgyud pa'i gser sku phul dus kyi phyag rtags// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang bskur gnas su ni/ /rol bas dga' ba'i rigs bdag tshul 'dzin cing / /dngos grub bzang po'i dpal gyis lham me ba/ /'dren mchog bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /che ba gsum ldan 'bras bu mchog brnyes rgyal ba'i yab gcig rdo rje 'chang / /'bras dus dbang gi chu bo'i 'byung gnas rol ba'i yum gyur bdag med ma/ /bde stong chen po'i grub mthas 'gros bzhi thim mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis bde stong chung ngu'i grub pa'i mtha' brnyes nag po pa/ /skad cig ma 'dres gsung rab yongs rdzogs sgrog mdzad ḍā ma ru pa ba/ /'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha'i rtse bas byis pa'i khrod gnas gnyis spangs zhabs/ /ma dag snang ba nyams kyis dag par sgyur mdzad ga ya dha ra dpal/ /skad gnyis smra bas rgyud gsum nyams len gter gyi sgo 'byed bla chen 'brog /tshad ma bzhi ldan gdams pa'i rgyal pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad rje btsun se/ /lta sgom gnyis kyi gdams pa drug gis rang rgyud rnam grol 'bar ba'i mtshan/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan gdams pas gangs can gsal mdzad brtse chen sa skya pa/ /phyi nang gsang sogs rten 'brel lnga yis lam gyi mthar son bsod nams rtse/ /phyogs lhung rnam spang zung 'jug lam gyis bdud las rnam rgyal grags pa'i mtshan/ /'du lugs gsum gyis sgro skur bral ba'i lam brnyes chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ting 'dzin nye rgyu gnas lugs gsum gyis ting 'dzin mchog brnyes 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /nyams gsum sgo nas gang yang ting nge 'dzin du srel mdzad dkon mchog dpal/ /byung rgyal gnad kyi drod gsum tshul bzhin skyong mdzad rje btsun bsod nams dpal/ /khrid lugs gsum gyis ting 'dzin bye brag rtogs pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/

/'dus pa gsum gyis sa mtshams yid gnyis bral ba dpal ldan pa/ /rten 'brel rnam gsum rang la 'jom pas re dogs bral ba bud+dha shrī/ /dam tshig rnam dag zab mo'i lam gyis gsung rab kun mkhyen bla ma rje/ /mi mthun phyogs spangs byin rlabs rgyun gyis gzhan gyi don mdzad mus pa rje/ /dbang bzhi'i brda yis don gnyis lhun grub kun dga'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab mchog /dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung zhing brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin puṇ+ya siṃ ha bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje'i gdeng g.yos kun gyi bstan srung gtso bo'i sku/ /sna tshogs rin chen las grub mdzes shing brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i snying por ldan zhing nor sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo bcas/ /rmad byung cho gas legs par rab gnas byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyur gyur a yig dang / /ri dwags kun gyi dbang po seng ge dang / /don mtshon brda yi mchog gyur rdo rje ltar/ /khrims gnyis brtan pa mi yi dbang po des/ /smon thang dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i pho brang nas/ /e wam̐ chos kyis mtho ba'i khang bzang du/ /mang thos don bzhin smra ba'i dge slong la/ /rnam dkar dad dang brtson pa'i stobs kyis phul/ /'di las bsgrubs pa'i dge tshogs gaṅga'i rgyun/ /skye 'phags kun gyis bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams dang / /mnyam du 'dres nas 'gro ba re re'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug phyir bsngo/ /gnas skabs kun tu mi dbang 'khor dang bcas/ /sku tshe ring zhing chab srid rgyas pa dang / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa stobs kyis skyong bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu 'dren mchog bla ma'i tshogs/ /rnyed dang bkur sti sgrub pas mchod byas nas/ /yang dag gdams pa'i dpal la longs spyod de/ /rdo rje 'dzin sa mngon du 'gyur bar shog

/man ngag rgyal po 'di yang srid mtha'i bar/ /rtag tu mi nyams rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi/ /phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu dar ba dang / /rnam mang 'gro bas nyams su len par shog /mda' gzhu ut+pal lcags kyus khams gsum 'gugs mdzad rig byed lha mo dang / /zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas dpal 'byor rgyas mdzad 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /glang chen zhal ldan 'gying ba'i gar gyis sgeg la dbang sgyur tshogs kyis bdag /lha mchog gsum gyis a seng rdo rje brtan pa'i dge legs bsgrub par mdzod/ /'jigs byed zhal bzhad khros pa'i gad rgyang sgrogs pa bstan srung gtso de dang / /shugs chen ma mchu 'phyang bas drag po'i las sgrub gdong bzhi gnyan pa'i mgon/ /rngam zhing myur ba'i gar gyis las rnams grub mdzad pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /a seng rdo rje brtan pa mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod/ /'di nyid thog mar bskul zhing mthar phyin nas/ /slar yang gnas 'dir spyan 'dren rgyal mtshan dpal/ /'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /bla ma'i tshogs kyi byin rlabs 'jug par shog/ ༈ //lam 'bras kyi smon lam bzhugs// ༄༅/ /phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung drin can rje/ /phul byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rdo rje 'chang / /phas rgol tshar gcod mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs/ /phan bde'i lam ston rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse'i spyan ras kyis/ /bu gcig pa la brtse ba'i ma bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor bdag la rgyun du legs gzigs nas/ /yid la smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /snang ba gsum gyi ma dag pa'i snang ba 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ srid gsum 'khor bar mtha' med 'gro ba rnams/ /sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /rgyun du gtses shing bde ba'i skabs med par/ /nges 'byung drag po gting nas skye bar shog /dal 'byor rnyed dka' legs brgyas bsgrubs pa'i lus rten phun tshogs 'di/

/rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba yi/ /rang bzhin rtogs nas skad cig g.yel med par/ /dal 'byor lus la snying po len par shog /las rgyu 'bras/ kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i bde sdug snang ba rnams/ /sngon bsags las kyi rjes su 'brang ba yi/ /las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i tshul rtogs nas/ /dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin byed par shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor drin can pha ma rnams/ /las kyi chu bo chen pos khyer mthong nas/ /nyams kyi snang ba la gsum smon pa byang chub kyi sems/ bcos min byams dang snying rjes drangs pa yi/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems mchog bskyed par shog /'jug pa byang chub kyi sems/ theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs/ /rgya chen byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /don dam byang chub kyi sems/ rtse gcig g.yo ba med pa'i zhi gnas dang / /gnas lugs 'khrul med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis/ /zung 'jug chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsgoms pa yis/ /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma sel bar shog /dag ba'i snang ba ni 'bras bu'i skabs su 'byung bas 'dir ma bris la/ mdo sngags mtshams sbyor ba ni/ pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /brgyud pa'i bka' ldan rgyud don ma lus rig /snying rjer ldan zhing dam tshig mchog srung ba'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mnyes byed shog /smin byed kyi dbang / de sogs mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma yis/ /rang lus gzhir gnas dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi la/ /rmad byung cho gas dbang bzhi bskur pa yis/ /lam bzang bzhi yi snod du 'gyur bar shog /dbang gi dam tshig dbang las thob pa'i dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs/ /srog dang bsdos te tshul bzhin bsrungs pa yis/ /'gal rkyen nyes tshogs mtha' dag rab bcom nas/

/sngags kyi lam rnams 'grub pa'i gzhir gyur shog /lta ba/ phyi nang dngos kun rang sems snang ba tsam/ /sems 'di ngo bo nyid min sgyu ma bzhin/ /de yang spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yi/ /dbang gis mtshan pa'i lta ba rtogs par shog /phyi bskyed rim/ thog med 'khor ba'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i/ /ma dag 'khrul ba'i snod bcud snang ba rnams/ /thabs la mkhas pas lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms pas/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor 'char bar shog /nang bskyed rim/ ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i lus kyi rtsa/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha ru bsgoms pa yis/ /rtsa rlung rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ /bum dbang gi lta ba/ snang stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo/ sna tshogs kun rtog skyed byed las kyi rlung / /sbyor ba bdun gyis dbang du byas pa yis/ /gtum mo'i me drod phyogs med rab sbar nas/ /lta ba/ gsal stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /gsum pa'i lam/ las kyi phyag rgya dngos sam ye shes la/ /'du shes gsum ldan sbyor bas snyoms zhugs nas/ /yas 'bab dga' ba bzhi yi rim gyis ni/ /lta ba/ bde stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /dbang bzhi pa'i lam/ lus dang ngag gi rba rlabs dbang gyur nas/ /ting 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs gsum bsgoms pas/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rba rlabs rengs pa yis/ /lta ba/ bde stong mchog gi ye shes skye bar shog /'dus pa gsum la mthar phyin nas 'phags ba'i sa lam mtshams sbyor ba ni/ de ltar rim gnyis bsam gtan bsgoms pa las/ /rang lus dag la nyams gsum skyes pa yis/ /'dus pa gsum gyi lam rnams mthar phyin nas/ /pad can lung bstan sprul sku'i zhal mthong shog /grub mtha' snyogs te bla ma na 'pho ba na grub mtha' re re la bla ma gang las/ dbang gang blang /

dkyil 'khor gang gnas gyur/ yon tan gang thob/ grub mtha' gang snyogs pa ste lnga lnga yod pa las/ grub mtha' dang po'i lnga ni/ sna tshogs sprul skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis/ /yan lag bdun gyis rtsa rnams mngon gyur nas/ /yon tan brgya phrag bdun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' gnyis pa'i lnga ni/ zung 'jug longs skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis/ /yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas/ /rigs drug so so'i skad du chos ston pa'i/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' gsum pa'i lnga ni/ bde chen chos skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas/ /nyi khri chig stong rgyu ba 'gags pa yis/ /bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' bzhi pa lnga ni/ dbyer med sku las dbang bzhi blangs pa yis/ /kun khyab rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas/ /rnam thar gnyis kyi 'bras bus brgyan pa yis/ /bde stong chen po'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /nye rgyus 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba ni/ bcu gnyis sa thob phyag rgya'i bha gar ni/ /dus gsum bde gshegs bcud 'dus thig le las/ /'bras dus dbang gi chu bo blangs pa yis/ /gtsug tor mchog tu 'gros bzhi thim par shog /'bras bu la gsum las/ rang don gyi che ba ni/ rten dang brten pa sku lngar gnas gyur cing / /gzhan don gyi che ba ni/ sna tshogs gdul bya'i 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor skong / /bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /dpag yas yon tan tshogs la dbang 'byor shog /go 'phang mchog de ma thob de srid du/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i drung du bdag skye zhing / /nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung ste/ /lam bzang 'di don sgom pa'i skal ldan shog

/tshe 'di nyid la'ang 'gal rkyen kun spangs shing / /dam pas bsngags pa'i mthun rkyen kun tshang nas/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa mthar phyin te/ /bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog /drin chen bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /dpal chen chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthu yis/ /rlabs chen smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /ces lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams rgyud la skye bar smon lam 'debs pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong rgyal khams pa seng ge'i mtha' can gyis sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// ༈ //rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i brgyad par gsungs pa'i smon lam dbang bzhi la sbyar ba// ༄༅/ /zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can rigs su skye/ /rtsa ba yan lag srung ba'i dam tshig can/ /tha mal rnam par rtog pas smyo med pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /kye yi rdo rje ngo bo nyid gsum ston/ /bum dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing / /sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin dang mi 'bral zhing / /zab mo'i rgyud rgyal chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba bdud rtsi lnga la spyod/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rtsa yig skyon med gsang dbang rigs su skye/ /thun chags rnam rtogs las srung dam tshig can/ /bsam gtan sgrib pa kun gyis smyo med pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /kye yi rdo rje rang byung ye shes ston/ /gsang dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing / /sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rdo rje dril bu ro rkyang dbu mar 'dzud/ /zab mo'i dril chen sgra ni sgrogs pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba khams dgu 'dus pa can/

/skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /bdud rtsi skyon med gsum pa'i rigs su skye/ /thig ler gnod pa rnam spong dam tshig can/ /gsum pa'i nyams dang ma bral smyo med pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /kye yi rdo rje lhan skyes ye shes ston/ /gsum pa bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing / /sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rdo rje dril bu mkha' gsang mnyam par sbyor/ /zab mo bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing / /btsun mo phyag rgya bsten dang mi 'bral ba/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /snying po skyon med bzhi pa'i rigs su skye/ /thig le 'dzag pa srung ba'i dam tshig can/ /sgrib pa gsum dang bral bas smyo med pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /kye yi rdo rje shin tu rnam dag ston/ /bzhi pa bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing / /sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rdo rje dril bu pad can mkha' gsang sbyor/ /zab mo bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing / /btsun mo pad+ma can gyi thig le 'dren/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i brgyad par gsungs pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad gnyis po dbang bzhi la sbyar ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du/ thar lam bla ma la re ba bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// ༈ //bde ba can gyi smon lam bzhugs// ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag tshal lo/ /mi mjed zhing gi ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /shākya'i rgyal pos 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho la/ /sangs rgyas zhing gis bsngags pa brjod rnams las/ /mchog gyur bde ba can la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhing de'i dbus su rin chen ljon pa'i drung / /lha mi'i ston pa 'dren mchog 'od dpag med/

/pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar brjid cing / /'od zer bye bas brgyan la gus phyag 'tshal/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /theg mchog bstan tshe ting 'dzin gyis myos pa'i/ /dgra bcom rnams kyang dman pa'i sems spangs nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sbyor mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs sprul pas skad cig re re zhing / /sna tshogs zhing gi mgon med 'gro rnams la/ /sna tshogs mdzad pas phan bde kun stsol ba'i/ /phrin las bsam mi khyab la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob la sogs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba nam mkha'i ltos gang zhing / /nyan thos dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rdul rnyed kyi/ /grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse chen sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i yongs 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rnam mang dge tshogs rnam dag smon lam mthus/ /zhing der brdzus te 'khrungs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs dang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /'od dpag med mgon thugs bskyed rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /bdag dang srid mtshor 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'i zhing gi mchog /bde ba can zhes grags pa der skyes nas/ /'od dpag med pa'i zhal mchog mthong bar shog /mthong ma thag tu gsung dbyangs rgya mtsho las/ /zab cing rgya che'i theg mchog thos gyur nas/ /dad dang shes rab gzungs dang ting 'dzin sogs/ /yon tan tshogs kyis bdag rgyud gang bar shog /rang lus zhing gi rdul snyed sprul pa yis/ /skad cig re rer phyogs bcu'i zhing bsgrod nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya chen gyis/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas ma lus mchod par shog /slar yang dag pa'i zhing der mgon po dang / /'dren mchog bla ma'i tshogs rnams mchod byas nas/ /theg chen chos tshul zab mo legs thob ste/

/byang chub spyod pa ma lus mthar phyin shog /snying rjes ma dag zhing gi 'gro rnams la/ /so so'i yid bzhin 'dod rgus tshim byas te/ /skal ba ji bzhin theg pa gsum bstan nas/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam du 'jog par shog /nam zhig go 'phang dam pa mngon gyur tshe/ /'khor du bsdus nas theg mchog bstan pa yis/ /byang chub spyod pa'i sa la bzhag byas nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog la 'god par shog /rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs 'bring du/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya'i dge slong gis/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi bkod pa bzung ba ltar/ /snod bcud dag pa'i zhing bzang thob par shog /rab dga'i sar gnas rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /dgongs pa gcig tu btab pa'i smon lam mchog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam ji lta bar/ /bdag dang 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni 'dun cing smon pa'i gnas thob par bya ba'i ched du shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// ༈ //bsngo ba mdor bsdus dang smon lam chen po bcu pa bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs dpon byed par 'dod pa'i bla ma bdag gis/ dge 'dun rnams chos spyod legs par zin/ rang gi mdun du bsngo rten bzhag nas/ sbyin bdag pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar te 'khod pa'i tshe/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ 'o dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi skyabs kyi 'og nas 'di ltar zhal mngon sum du gyur pa'i dge 'dun rnams la tsha ba'i bsnyen bkur zhes pa'am/ gung tshigs zhes pa'am/ gral 'gyed dang bcas pa sogs gang yod kyi skabs thob dang sbyar te/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa'i skabs don spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan bde 'byung ba dang /

khyad par dmigs pa'i yul 'di zhes bya ba'i sngon 'gro'am/ gshegs rdzong la dmigs nas bsgrub par gda' bas rjes su yi rang / de las byung ba'i dge ba bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyid pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bsngo ba'i mthun 'gyur thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ phyogs bcu na zhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po la dgongs su gsol/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa rang dang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed yod pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas/ tshe las 'das pa rnams kyi ming nas smos te/ 'di rnams kyis thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig rang dang gzhan gyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig ces pa lan gsum brjod/ de lta bu'i go 'phang ma thob pa'i skye ba dang srid pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten rnam par dag pa dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus rin po che thob par gyur cig rten der yang khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig rab tu byung nas nyes ltung phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos par tshul khrims kyi phung po mthar phyin par gyur cig gzhi tshul khrims la gnas nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa phyin ci ma log pa sgrub par gyur cig bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bus bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig

ces brjod/ yang gshin por dge rtsa rgya chen bsgrubs nas bsngo ba rgyas par byed dgos na/ dgongs gsol sngar dang 'dra/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sbyin pa las byung ba dang / tshul khrims las byung ba dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed yod pa rnams dang / dmigs pa'i yul rang nyid kyis ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang / gti mug med pas bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed bsags pa rnams dang / de dag gi 'brel pa shul na mchis pa rnams kyis 'di'i ched du bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong bgyis pa dang / dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgrub mchod bgyis pa dang / gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod bgyis pa la sogs pa rnam dkar gyi dge ba ji snyed bsags pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te/ dmigs pa'i yul 'di zhes bya ba'i phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing phyi bzhin du rjes su 'jug par gyur cig rjes su zhugs nas rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bar do dang bcas pa las grol nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de lta bu'i go 'phang ma thob pa'i skye ba dang / srid pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten rnam par dag pa lha'am mi'i lus rin po che thob par gyur cig rten der yang bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig lta ba rnam par dag pa bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i don rtogs par gyur cig sgom pa rnam par dag pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par gyur cig spyod pa rnam par dag pa thabs shes zung 'jug gi spyod pas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par gyur cig

'bras bu rnam par dag pa sku gnyis zung du 'jug pas phrin las rgyun mi chad par gyur cig ces brjod/ yang spro na/ rten der yang gzhi dad pa brtan po dang ldan par gyur cig rgyu snying rje chen po dang ldan par gyur cig grogs brtson 'grub drag po dang ldan par gyur cig ngo bo shes rab dri ma med pa dang ldan par gyur cig gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mnyes par byed nus par gyur cig ting nge 'dzin mu mtha' med pas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug par gyur cig thabs rmad du byung bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar gyur cig phrin las gzhal du med pas sems can gyi re 'dod yid bzhin du skong bar gyur cig ces brjod/ yang spro na/ rten der yang theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang mjal zhing de dag rtag tu mnyes par byed nus par gyur cig theg pa chen po zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa'i dam pa'i chos dang mi 'bral zhing de dag la rtag tu longs spyod par gyur cig kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod de skabs thob dang sbyar ro/ /yang gang zag mchog 'jig rten gyi 'dren par grags pa'i ched du bsngo na/ dgongs gsol sngar dang 'dra/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas/ gzhan yang thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pas bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rang dang gzhan gyis ji snyed bsags pa dang / lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dngos po thams cad gdul bya'i don du zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje 'di zhes bgyi bas thog drangs bla ma gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi'o/

/de ltar phul ba la brten nas rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de dag gi zag pa med pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs dam pa 'jug par gyur cig de'i rjes su tshe 'das gzhan gyi bsngo ba dang sbrel dgos na/ de dag gi byin gyis rlabs dang / 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu la brten nas zhes sogs sngar gyi gshin bsngo gong ma dang sbrel ba lan gsum brjod/ mi dgos na snga ma nyid lan gsum brjod/ yang mchog bsngo'i tha snyad dgos kyang don la dkor la spyod pa snying rje'i yul yin na/ dgongs gsol snga ma dang 'dra/ bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa yang sngar gyi gshin bsngo gnyis po gang rung zhig smros nas/ bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sku tshe thogs ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig sa dang lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur cig sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bsgrod nas sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs thams cad myur du mngon du byed nus pa gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas gson po'i don du bsngo na dgongs gsol mi dgos/ gzhan yang 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas/ sbyin bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig rlung mkhris dang ban kan la sogs pa'i nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig gdon bgegs dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur cig 'phral gyi rkyen du gyur pa'i rmi lam ngan pa dang /

mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig yang gang zag mchog gi sku rim byed dus yin na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'di zhes bya ba'am/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di zhes bya ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ de thams cad kyi mjug tu/ gzhan yang 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma gong ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring bar gyur cig rnam par dka' ba'i phrin las dang 'gro don phyogs bcu thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa khyad par can gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig de dag gi byin gyis rlabs la brten nas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig sa phyogs 'di nyid kyis gtsor byas yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po rnams su char chu dus su 'bab par gyur cig lo phyugs rtag tu legs par gyur cig

mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig mtshon gyi bskal pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig 'thab rtsod dang 'khrug long thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig sems can thams cad phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad rang rang gi rdzas dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug dag gis chog shes par gyur cig tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa byang nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs zhes sogs dang / 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang / /zhes sogs dang / 'jam dpal ji ltar zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang / rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi zhes sogs long skabs dang bstun nas brjod/ khyad par du gshin don du yin na/ ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong zhing / /zhes sogs dang / rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang / byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /zhes sogs brjod/ mchog bsngo dang po lta bu la yin na/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /zhes sogs dang / dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de nas/ bsod nams stobs chen zhes sogs dang / sems can de dag thams cad ni/ /zhes sogs dang / thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de nas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig po/ /zhes sogs bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i bsngo ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa ci shes brjod/ nam mkha' dang mnyam dge rtsa rnams/ /nam mkha'i mkha' klas sems can la/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsngo ba'i tshul/ /nam mkha' bzang pos bskul nas bris// //dge'o// ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/ tshe rabs kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /bkur sti rnyed dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / /rim gro bya ba'i rnam pa dpag med pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog

1 /rgyal ba'i dam chos kun gyi tshig don rnams/ /gzung zhing nyams pa med par bsrung ba dang / /chos tshul zab mo yang dag gzung ba yi/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 2 /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa nas brtsams te/ /myang 'das bar gyi mdzad pa kun ston pa/ /drung du 'gro zhing chos kun sdud byed pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 3 /gzhan don sgrub byed bsdu dngos rnam bzhi dang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs byed phyin drug sogs/ /rgyal sras spyod pa thams cad legs spyad pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 4 /sems can kun la dam pa'i chos bstan pas/ /dad sogs dbang pos smin nas 'phags pa'i lam/ /dngos su skye zhing sgrib pa spong rung ba'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 5 /ba spu'i khung bur zhing gi rdul snyed kyi/ /'jig rten khams kun sprul nas de dag tu/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras spyod pa kun ston pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 6 /snod bcud zhing gi skyon rnams rab spangs nas/ /gser gyi gzhi dang dge bcu spyod pa sogs/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 7 /theg pa mchog la 'jug phyir byang sems dang / /gcig tu gzhan la phan pa'i bsam sbyor kun/ /rnam pa kun tu gcig par bya ba yi/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 8 /thog mar sems mchog bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ /bar du yang dag lam gyi sbyor ba kun/ /tha mar 'bras bu mchog gi don yod pa'i/ /smon lam chen mo myur du 'grub par shog /tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs byung ba'i/ /don gnyis mthar phyin bla med rdzogs byang chub/ /'gro ba'i don du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog 10 /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde las sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu btab pa thams cad smon lam chen po bcur 'dus par gsungs pa'i don byang sa dang /

mdo sde rgyan dang / 'jug 'grel gyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzhan phan gyi bsam pa cung zad dang ldan pa bsod nams seng ges cho 'phrul chen po'i rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i nyi ma la tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa 'di kun gyis 'dzin pa dang kha 'don du mdzad par zhu// dge'o// ༈ //smon lam chen po bcu pa bzhugs// ༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum 'gro la byin rlabs char rgyun gyis/ /dge legs lo thog rgyas mdzad drin can rje/ /mtshungs med bla ma brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /khyab bdag rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas/ /sgrib med mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro la phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ /smon lam rgyal po 'di ltar btab pa rnams/ /tshul bzhin 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dus gsum gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras sa chen la bzhugs byang sems rnams/ /smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu btab pa/ /smon lam chen po bcur 'dus 'dir brjod bya// ༈ //bdag dang gzhan gyis 'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis nye bar mtshon nas/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na so so'i skye bo dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'am/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pas bsdus pa'am/ thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa las byung ba'am/ 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa las byung ba'am/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / sgom pa las byung ba gang ci yang rung ste/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum du byas pa dang / byed par 'gyur ba dang /

de bzhin du byed pa'i bsod nams thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag cag rnams dang / dmigs pa'i yul che ge mos thog drangs pa'i mar gyur nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du sangs rgyas ma lus pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro lhag ma med pa mtha' dag bya ba'i phyir rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa mos pa rgya chen pos rnam par dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par sangs rgyas 'byung ba bgrangs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim gro chen po bya ba rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig tshe rabs kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /bkur sti rnyed dang sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang / /rim gro bya ba'i rnam pa dpag med pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /smon lam rgyal po dang po btab pa ltar/ /bdag kyang lhag bsam dag pas tshul bzhin 'debs/ /'gro ba'i don phyir myur du 'grub par shog /sangs rgyas phrin las 'gro la 'jug pa dang / /chos dbyings mkha' ltar kun la khyab pa dang / /kun rdzob brten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /rgya chen smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog 1 de ltar sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshul yang dag par gzung ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub yang dag par yongs su gzung ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par sangs rgyas 'byung ba bgrangs pa thams cad kyi dam pa'i chos rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig

rgyal ba'i dam chos kun gyi tshig don rnams/ /gzung zhing nyams pa med par bsrung ba dang / /chos tshul zab mo yang dag gzung ba yi/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ gnyis pa zhes sbyar ro/ 2 /de ltar dam pa'i chos gzung ba'i slad du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad kyis dga' ldan gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa thog mar mdzad de/ 'pho ba dang / gshegs pa dang / lhums na bzhugs pa dang / bltams pa dang / gzhon nu rol pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i drung du 'gro zhing mchod pa dang / chos kyis yang dag par bsdu ba'i sbyor ba sngon du 'gro bar thams cad dus gcig tu bsgrub pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par sangs rgyas 'byung ba bgrangs pa thams cad kyi gzhan don du 'gro ba rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa nas brtsams te/ /myang 'das bar gyi mdzad pa kun ston pa/ /drung du 'gro zhing chos kun sdud byed pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ gsum pa zhes sbyar ro/ 3 /de ltar rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus pa bsdus nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad shin tu rgyas pa/ che ba/ tshad med pa/ tha mi dad pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyis bsdus pa/ yongs su sbyong ba/ yan lag dang / nye ba'i yan lag tu bcas pa/

sgrub pa dang / mtshan nyid 'dra ba dang / mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba dang / 'du ba dang / rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par gyur pa'i sa lam thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du ston pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyang bar bya ba'i gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa rab tu sbyin pas bstan pa'i sems bskyed pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par spyod pa bgrangs pa thams cad du rgyun mi chad par mngon par bsgrub pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig byang sems spyod pa tshad med rgya che ba/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs byed phyin drug sogs/ /rgyal sras sa lam thams cad legs bsgrub pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ /bzhi pa zhes sbyar ro/ 4 /de ltar rang don pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad gzugs can dang / gzugs med pa dang / 'du shes can dang / 'du shes med pa dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min dang / sgo nga las skyes pa dang / mngal nas skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang / rdzus te skyes pa dang / khams gsum du gtogs pa/ 'gro ba drug tu 'dus pa/ skye ba thams cad du gtogs pa/ ming dang gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i sems can ma lus pa thams cad yongs su smin par bya bar sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzud pa dang / 'gro ba bgrangs pa thams cad rnam par gcad pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par sems can gyi khams bgrangs pa thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig

sems can kun la dam pa'i chos bstan pas/ /dad sogs dbang po smin nas 'phags pa'i lam/ /dngos su skye zhing sgrib pa spong rung ba'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ lnga pa zhes sbyar ro/ 5 /de ltar sems can smin par byed pa'i thabs su 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rgyas pa dang / tha gru che ba dang / tshad med pa dang / phra ba dang / rags pa dang / snrel zhi dang / spyi'u tshugs dang / ngos phyal ba dang / 'jug pa'i khyim can dang / mig 'phrul ltar rnam par 'byed pa dang / phyogs bcu rnam pa tha dad pa rnam par 'byed pa la 'jug pa ma lus pa ye shes kyi khong du chud par mngon sum du 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par 'jig rten gyi khams bgrangs pa thams cad du 'jug pa rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig shin tu rgyas shing tha gru che ba sogs/ /mig 'phrul ltar 'byed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams/ /rnam par 'byed la 'jug pa thogs med pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ drug pa zhes sbyar ro/ 6 /de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams yang dag par bstan nas/ zhing thams cad zhing gcig dang / zhing thams cad du yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba yongs su sbyong ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing tshad med pa dag 'od rnam par bkod pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan pa dang / yongs su dag pa'i lam dang ldan pas nyon mongs pa thams cad bsal ba dang / sems can ye shes kyi 'byung gnas tshad med pas rab tu gang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul rgya chen po la yang dag par gzhol ba dang / sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par bstan cing shin tu tshim par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/

nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par sangs rgyas kyi zhing bgrangs pa thams cad du yongs su sbyong ba rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig snod bcud zhing gi skyon rnams rab spangs nas/ /gser gyi gzhi dang dge bcu spyod pa sogs/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ bdun pa zhes sbyar ro/ 7 /de ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bsam pa dang sbyor ba gcig par bya ba dang / 'gran zla med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gsag par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dmigs pa gcig pas mnyam pa nyid du bya ba dang / rtag tu rgyun mi chad par byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs shing mi 'bral bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba ci dgar bstanaṃ par bya ba dang / rang gi sems bskyed pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu ye shes kyi khong du chud par bya ba dang / ma nyams shing rjes su 'gro ba'i mngon par shes pa rab tu thob par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par rgyu bar bya ba dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du snang ba thob par bya ba dang / skye ba thams cad du rang gi lus rjes su 'gro bar bya ba dang / theg pa chen pos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par spyod pa bgrangs pa thams cad du theg pa chen po la 'dzud pa rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig theg pa mchog la 'jug phyir byang sems dang / /gcig tu gzhan la phan pa'i bsam sbyor kun/

/rnam pa kun tu gcig par bya ba yi/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ brgyad pa zhes sbyar ro/ 8 /de ltar gzhan don 'dres shing nye bar 'dres pa'i mthu la brten nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo la yang dag par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad par bya ba dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las don yod par bya ba dang / mthong ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi chos nges par 'thob par bya ba dang / dbyangs brjod ma thag tu ye shes khong du chud par bya ba dang / dad par gyur ma thag tu nyon mongs pa ldog par bya ba dang / sman gyi rgyal po chen po lta bu'i lus thob par bya ba dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i lus thob par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa spyad pa'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par spyod pa bgrangs pa thams cad du don yod pa rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig thog mar sems mchog bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ /bar du yang dag lam gyi sbyor ba kun/ /tha mar 'bras bu mchog gi don yod pa'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ dgu pa zhes sbyar ro/ 9 /de ltar tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mthu las/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba dang / byis pa'i lam gcig dang tha mi dad par byis pa'i lam thams cad du tsheṃ skye ba dang / byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul chen po mthu dang ye shes kyi rjes su 'gro bas sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas 'byung bar dkyil 'khor gdal ba la rtogs par byed/

zhi bar byed/ 'thob par byed cing bstan par bya ba dang / gcig mngon du yang dag par rtogs pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad mya ngan las 'das pas rgyas par bya ba dang / dbyangs gcig brjod pas sems can thams cad kyi sems tshim par bya ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan kyang spyod pa'i stobs rgyun mi chad pa dang / ye shes chen pos chos thams cad 'byung bar byed pa bstan par bya ba dang / chos shes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / sgyu ma'i mngon par shes pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par rgya che ba/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa/ bskal pa bgrangs par mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa bgrangs pa thams cad du theg pa chen po mngon par sgrub pa rgyun mi chad pa'i smon lam chen po mngon par 'grub par gyur cig tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs byung ba'i/ /don gnyis mthar phyin bla med rdzogs byang chub/ /'gro ba'i don du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /smon lam chen po myur du 'grub par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas sogs tshigs bcad gnyis 'gre ste/ bcu pa zhes sbyar ro/ 10 /gzhan yang gnas skabs kun tu phan bde'i 'byung gnas lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu rgyas shing srid mtha'i bar du gnas pa dang / bstan pa'i 'byung gnas yongs 'dzin gong ma brgyud par bcas pa thams cad kyis gzhan don mdzad pa'i thugs kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub pa dang / da ltar thos bsam bsgoms pas rang rgyud sbyangs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od kyis thub bstan gsal bar mdzad pa'i skyes chen thams cad sku tshe brtan zhing phrin las nyi ma'i 'od kyis thub bstan pad mtsho kun tu khyab pa dang / dge 'dun thams cad rnam par dkar ba'i tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa la gnas nas chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas skye rgu kun gyis mchod pa'i 'os su gyur te/

dad pa dang 'byor par ldan pa'i 'gro ba du mas rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / rim gro dpag tu med pas mchod pa la brten nas yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing / bkra shis dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis khyab par gyur cig rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyi smon lam 'grub pa dang / /rgyal khams kun tu dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa ji bzhin 'byor gyur cig /dge 'dun thams cad rnam dkar tshul khrims la/ /legs par gnas shing thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus/ /rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas par shog /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa la sogs pa/ /chos spyod rnam bcus bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas skye rgus mchod gyur te/ /chos dang dge legs phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /sras bcas rgyal bas 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /rgya chen smon lam rnam mang btab pa ltar/ /bdag kyang lhag bsam dag pas tshul bzhin 'debs/ /'gro ba'i don phyir myur du 'grub par shog /sangs rgyas phrin las 'gro la 'jug pa dang / /chos dbyings mkha' ltar kun la khyab pa dang / /kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /rgya chen smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /byang sa dang / mdo ste rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang / bslab btus dang / 'jug 'grel rnams las sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu btab pa rnams smon lam chen po bcur 'dus par gsungs pa'i smon lam bcu po'i tshig gi ngo bo rnams mdo sde sa bcu pa'i lung ji lta ba bzhin bris shing / mtshams sbyor gyi tshig tsam sbyar ba 'di ni dbu mar smra ba bsod nams seng ges thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
